title: NTA UGC NET December 2025 E Certificate Download
documentsRequired: Application number, roll number, DOB, registered email/mobile
howToApply:
1. Visit https://ugcnet.nta.nic.in
2. Click e-Certificate download / DigiLocker
3. Enter application number and DOB/password
4. Download JRF / Assistant Professor certificate
5. Save PDF for job applications
shortDescription: NTA UGC NET December 2025 E-Certificate Download – digital certificate for qualified candidates on ugcnet.nta.nic.in.
content:
UGC NET December 2025 e-certificates are available for candidates who qualified for Junior Research Fellowship and/or Assistant Professor eligibility.

Download from ugcnet.nta.nic.in or DigiLocker after official activation. Certificate number can be verified online for recruitment.
